method: 32 fresh seeds on both sides per exact board against 18 equally family-weighted references reconstructed from the official v35 API, executed by v36. Seven specified items, no Seals and neutral weather. The 5-2 forecast blends full and best tested low-roll combat using a separate conditional shop-budget study; it is not a ranked win rate or unconditional whole-game finish probability. Early progression is illustrative and unscored. Level 8 extensions and level 9 caps are optional after 5-2 and do not set tiers.

limitations: References are reconstructed from API v35 records, not live human opponents.
Conditional forecasts are not unconditional finish rates. Whole-game acquisition results are kept in the private report.
Seven specific item recipes are standardized for combat and are not guaranteed rewards.
The conditional shop study freezes opponent future purchases; it does not model future contesting.
